name: Free! Eternal Summer Visual Novel
source: Due to health complications, you spent your first year at Iwatobi High in isolation. Because of this, you don’t have many friends and being more active will improve your health. The game starts off in the beginning of second year and you decide to join a club in order to kill two birds with one stone, meeting some cute guys in the process
